newsitem.title: USA: Stratasys sees 92 pct gain in Q3 revenues.
newsitem.headline: Stratasys sees 92 pct gain in Q3 revenues.

text.p: Stratasys Inc said Wednesday it expects to report 1996 third quarter revenues of about $4.4 million, up 92 percent from $2.3 million a year ago.
Scott Crump, chairman and chief executive officer, cited continued strong sales of its FDM product line and strong additional revenues from a new Genisys DeskTop 3D-Printer.

Stratasys makes prototyping systems for automotive, aerospace, industrial, electronic, medical, and consumer products. The company's patented Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) and Genisys rapid prototyping processes create three dimensional plastic and wax prototype parts directly from three dimensional computer assisted design systems.
Crump said the company expects additional 1997 revenue growth from a new large modeling system, Stratasys-8000, which is targeted at the automotive and aerospace markets.
The first commercial shipment of the Stratasys-8000 is targeted for the second quarter of 1997 to allow more time for further systems testing and refining.
